killedBy: vendored third-party source (issue #771) stores V8's BSD licence whole, from its copyright line to its disclaimer
THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md is generated, not hand-edited matches what renderNotices() produces right now -- run `npm run notices` to fix
why: The stored V8 licence ends in a newline, so reading it untrimmed changes the fenced block in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md. The stored licence must end at its disclaimer.
